info.title: ZME Private Media Library
info.description: A private media library and download desk for discovering movies, series, anime, music, and books, finding releases, and sending them to the user's own downloaders. Local roles and resource ownership restrict every operation.

post.summary: Create a download from an opaque resource reference
post.description: Supply downloaderId to create a remote task (Idempotency-Key required). Omit downloaderId to prepare a local download without creating a remote task. For kind=magnet open href through the system; for kind=file save the proxied attachment and let the system open it. File href values hide the original torrent site. Local metadata and file capabilities expire after five minutes; the magnet URI itself does not. A local response does not imply that a client started or finished. Local downloads are not included in the remote task list.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required when downloaderId is supplied. Reuse only for the identical remote request. Omit for local preparation; local calls issue a fresh temporary capability.

get.description: Read an owned remote task or an unexpired local download. Local downloads are temporary and are not included in the remote task collection.

get.summary: Read a file using a temporary local download capability
get.description: Use the exact href returned by createDownload when downloaderId is omitted. Possession of the unexpired encrypted ID authorizes this file read without cookies or DPoP credentials. Do not send ZME credentials to any other origin. Magnet sources have no file content.
